prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, pick it up then move it - if heavy, move to designated area. If not visible, scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesignatedArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <SubTree ID = PickupObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickupObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDesignatedArea
	END
